name: Letterbox
description: Cinema bars: covers the top and bottom (or the sides) so the picture shows at a wide film ratio.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Width / height of the picture left between the bars (2.39 is cinemascope)

params.name: progress
params.description: How far the bars have slid in: 0 none, 1 full; animate it with keyframes

params.name: offset
params.description: Moves the open part up (negative) or down, part of the bar size

params.name: softness
params.description: Soft edge of the bars, part of the frame height

params.name: color
params.description: Bar color; its alpha makes the bars see-through
